title: Software Engineer II
description:
We are seeking **Associate Engineers** to join the Operations Data and Analytics organization. These are **individual contributor engineering roles** reporting directly to the Director and focused on developing and supporting enterprise capabilities across ServiceNow, IT Service Management, automation, integrations, and operational engineering.

A primary focus of these positions will be the development and support of enterprise capabilities for **Incident Management, Problem Management, Change Management, and the CMDB capabilities and configuration data that enable those processes** .

This role is intended for engineers who already have professional software development or platform engineering experience and are looking to build deeper expertise within a large-scale enterprise environment. This is an early-career engineering position, but candidates should have experience working in a professional technology organization and a demonstrated foundation in software development.

Associate Engineers will work closely with experienced engineers while taking ownership of increasingly complex development assignments. The role provides an opportunity to develop deeper expertise in ServiceNow development, ITSM, APIs, automation, CMDB, production engineering, and Site Reliability Engineering practices.

  

* Develop and support integrations between ServiceNow and enterprise platforms using **REST APIs, web services, events, and related integration technologies** .
* Work with structured data formats such as JSON and XML.
* Develop automation that reduces manual effort and improves engineering and operational efficiency.
* Help develop reusable integration patterns and services.
* Develop and maintain integrations that populate, update, or consume CMDB and operational data.
* Troubleshoot integration, data, and production issues, escalating or collaborating with experienced engineers as appropriate.
* Look for opportunities to replace repetitive manual processes with effective automation.
* Apply sound software engineering practices across application design, development, automated testing, code review, deployment, and production support.
* Develop maintainable, testable, and well-documented software.
* Use source control, automated testing, and CI/CD as part of the engineering lifecycle.
* Participate actively in design discussions and code reviews.
* Apply feedback from senior engineers and incorporate established technical standards and reusable patterns into development work.
* Develop an understanding of enterprise application architecture, reliability, security, and maintainability.
* Participate in Agile planning, development, testing, deployment, and retrospective activities.
* Remain current on relevant technologies and continuously develop technical capabilities.
* Take increasing technical ownership and operate with greater independence as experience grows.

  

At American Express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.

As part of Team Amex, you’ll experience our powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career. Here, your voice and ideas matter, your work makes an impact, and together, you will help us define the future of American Express.

  

We back you with benefits that support your holistic well-being so you can be and deliver your best. This means caring for you and your loved ones' physical, financial, and mental health, as well as providing the flexibility you need to thrive personally and professionally:

* Competitive base salaries
* Bonus incentives

* Generous paid parental leave policies (depending on your location)
* Free access to global on-site wellness centers staffed with nurses and doctors (depending on location)

American Express is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, disability status, age, or any other status protected by law.

title: Principal Software Engineer
description:
About PSG-CP

Pearson is the world's lifelong learning company, and PSG-CP (Pearson Software Group - Content Platform) is the organization powering how that learning gets created, enriched, delivered, and measured. PSG-CP's focus is on content. We handle authoring, semantic enrichment, transformation, delivery, assessment, and analytics, serving every Pearson line of business and millions of learners worldwide. We are reshaping the platform around AI in a serious way, and this Principal Engineer role is pivotal in shaping the vision, strategy, and execution of technology and architecture.

This is a high-impact, hands-on technical leadership role focused on improving engineering effectiveness, accelerating delivery, and ensuring technical excellence across the organization. You will not be embedded within a single team; instead, you will work across teams on PSG-CP initiatives, complex technical challenges, and architectural decisions.

You will partner closely with Engineering Managers, Staff Engineers, Product, and DevOps to assess technical feasibility, and drive architecture decisions for future high-impact, AI-native PSG-CP capabilities.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Lead technical feasibility reviews and share architecture for enterprise-scale AI-native PSG-CP capabilities
* Provide hands-on technical leadership across multiple squads, focusing on high-impact initiatives and critical path work
* Unblock complex technical challenges that span systems, teams, or domains
* Lead and contribute to architecture and system design decisions, ensuring scalability, simplicity, and long-term maintainability
* Drive technical consistency and best practices across teams (design patterns, standards, tooling)
* Partner with the Engineering Manager and Staff Engineers to support delivery without taking on people management responsibilities
* Contribute directly to code when needed, especially in high-risk or high-priority areas
* Mentor and guide senior engineers and technical leads through coaching, design discussions, and knowledge sharing
* Partner with internal and external stakeholders to identify, assess, and co-develop Ai-native innovative capabilities to PSG-CP

**Required Skills and Competencies:**

* Prior experience building content authoring / management platforms is a must
* **Full-Stack Engineering, Modern Development Tools (Advanced):** Build and prototype end-to-end across frontend, backend, and infrastructure. Experience with at least one of the following: Front End like React, Angular; Back End like Java, Spring, Node JS, Python
* **Cloud Computing, API Management, DevOps, Data Security, Information Security (Advanced):** Lead technical execution and ensure compliance. Prior working experience in a cloud computing environment like AWS/GCP is highly desired
* **Collaboration, Innovation, Cross-Functional Working, Technical Acumen, Problem Solving (Advanced):** Influence across teams and partners, shape ideas, and drive differentiated solutions.
* **Comfort with Ambiguity, Builder Mindset (Advanced):** Operate effectively in undefined, fast-moving, early-stage environments.
* Ability to operate as a force multiplier across teams, elevating overall engineering quality and speed
* Strong architectural thinking with a focus on scalability, simplicity, and business impact
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to influence without authority both technical and non-technical stakeholders
* Self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced, and evolving environment
* Demonstrated ability to work with global teams across time zones

**Qualifications (Education & Experience):**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent experience
* 15+ years of experience building and scaling full-stack applications
* Proven experience operating at a staff or principal level, influencing multiple teams or large systems
* Strong background in system design, distributed systems, and API architecture using event driven microservices
* Demonstrated ability to solve ambiguous, cross-cutting technical problems
* Experience driving technical strategy, standards, and architecture across teams

title: Software Engineer - AI Platform
description:
**AI Platform Software Engineer – Platform Engineering**
========================================================

With a global team of 5600+ IT professionals, DHL IT Services **connects people** and keeps the global economy running **by continuously innovating and creating sustainable digital solutions**. We work **beyond global borders** and push boundaries across **all dimensions of logistics**. You can **leave your mark** shaping the **technology backbone** of the biggest logistics company of the world. All our locations have earned the **#GreatPlaceToWork** certification, reflecting our commitment to exceptional employee experiences.

**Digitalization. Simply delivered.**  
At IT Services, we are passionate about AI. Our Platform Engineering Transformation team is continuously expanding. No matter your level of AI Platform Software Engineer proficiency, you can always grow within our diverse environment.

*#DHL #DHLITServices #GreatPlace #Digitalplatforms*

**Grow together**

**About the role:**

As a **AI Platform Software Engineer** within the Platform Engineering Transformation Team, you will be at the center of this journey.

You will help bring to life and continuously improve the Agentic AI Platform, an internal development platform for hosting AI agents. This involves development, configuration, monitoring, verification, and maintenance. The roles of service and product ownership are also be part of the job.

We currently use Java, Python, Google ADK, React, Kafka, PostgreSQL, Google GKE, and Apigee Gateway technologies, among others. The product currently hosts AI agents mostly written in Python and Google ADK, and also works with GitHub, Artifactory, GitHub Actions, SonarQube, and more.

Our platform and tools serve thousands of engineering and management colleagues across the company. You will work with a team of highly skilled and engaged professionals in multiple locations, bring new ideas to life, and find ways to continuously bring more innovation, integration, and developer experience into our services.

**Major responsibilities and requirements:**

* **Platform development – “From idea to deployment”**
  + Proven experience in a software engineering role or a similar position, with a solid understanding of DevOps and software development.
  + Proficient in CI/CD and DevOps. Experience with scripting languages.
  + Proficient in at least one programming language: Java, Python, or JavaScript/TypeScript.
  + Experience with AI Agent development or deployment.
  + Knowledge of related technologies such as K8S (GKE, AKS or OpenShift), Git, Kafka, and/or application monitoring (Grafana, Prometheus, Loki) is advantageous.
* **Platform maintenance and support - “You build it, you run it”.**
  + Product administration and technical third-level support, including patching and bug fixing, are integral parts of the job.
  + Good familiarity with cloud services, particularly Google Cloud, along with Kubernetes, containerization, infrastructure, and networking concepts.
  + Experience with hosting or developing software development tools and monitoring them is a plus.
* **Collaboration**
  + Excellent communication skills, with the ability to express opinions openly and a commitment to fostering a culture of continuous improvement.
  + Willingness and flexibility to adjust working hours to better align with EU-based users is a plus.
  + Strong problem-solving abilities and keen attention to detail are essential for this role.

**Ready to embark on the journey? Here’s what we are looking for:**  
We require a proven track record in software engineering, DevOps, and maintenance. Experience with Scrum, Kubernetes, and microservices is a plus.

You have a can-do attitude and an open mindset. You are able to work independently, prioritize and organize your tasks, and contribute to the project. Working in a multinational environment, you can expect cross-region collaboration with teams around the globe; therefore, advanced spoken and written English is necessary.

**An array of benefits for you:**

* Annual Leave – 42 days off apart from Public / National Holidays
* Medical Insurance - Self + Spouse + 2 children. An option to opt for Voluntary Parental Insurance (Parents / Parent -in-laws) at a nominal premium covering preexisting diseases
* In House training programs - professional and technical training certifications
* Flexible Work options

**Great Team**  
If the role sounds interesting to you, please let us know and join us in delivering the future of AI and Platform engineering for DHL logistics. Together with the strong support of a multinational & diverse team, we are working on our common ambition – AI. Looking forward to having you onboard!

**DHL is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other protected characteristic.**

description:

**Job Description**
-------------------

**Your Profile**

* Design, develop, and maintain WLAN Host Applications for broadband gateways, routers, access points, and connected devices.
* Develop WiFi application features related to WLAN configuration, monitoring, diagnostics, performance optimization, and security.
* Work with hostapd, wpa\_supplicant, NetworkManager, and other wireless networking frameworks to implement WLAN functionalities.

* Analyze WLAN performance issues and develop solutions to improve throughput, roaming, latency, and device connectivity.
* Develop and maintain networking applications utilizing TCP/IP, DHCP, DNS, NAT, QoS, and routing protocols.
* Implement WiFi management features using TR-181, TR-069, EasyMesh, Multi-AP, and Broadband Forum standards.
* Participate in debugging, troubleshooting, and optimization of WLAN applications on Embedded Linux platforms.
* Contribute to software design, code reviews, architecture discussions, and product enhancements.
* Support automation and validation teams during feature verification and production deployment.

**Your Role**

* Minimum 4-8 years of experience in WLAN/WiFi Software Development.
* Strong programming expertise in C and C++ on Linux-based platforms.
* Hands-on experience with WLAN technologies including IEEE 802.11 a/b/g/n/ac/ax (WiFi 5, WiFi 6, WiFi 6E).
* Strong understanding of Linux networking stack and socket programming.
* Experience with hostapd, wpa\_supplicant, cfg80211, mac80211, and wireless networking components.
* Knowledge of EasyMesh, Multi-AP, Band Steering, Client Steering, and Mesh Networking concepts.
* Familiarity with RDK-B architecture, CCSP framework, WebPA, and TR-181 data models is preferred.
* Experience with debugging tools such as Wireshark, tcpdump, gdb, and Linux tracing utilities.
* Understanding of WiFi security protocols including WPA2, WPA3, 802.1X, and Radius.
* Exposure to Agile development methodologies, Git, Jenkins, CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing frameworks.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills.

* We offer a range of career paths and internal opportunities within Capgemini Group.

* At Capgemini, you can work on cutting-edge connected device, broadband, and networking projects with industry leaders or create innovative solutions that shape the future of connected experiences.
* Collaborate with global teams and gain exposure to next-generation technologies including WiFi 7, EasyMesh, IoT, and Edge Connectivity solutions.

Capgemini is a global business and technology transformation partner, helping organizations to accelerate their dual transition to a digital and sustainable world, while creating tangible impact for enterprises and society. With its strong over 55-year heritage, Capgemini is trusted by its clients to unlock the value of technology to address the entire breadth of their business needs. As an **Embedded Software Engineer** at Caterpillar, you will develop embedded software for electronics control systems supporting engine programs. Areas of responsibility include configuration, integration, build, and testing of embedded software on engine systems; testing software for embedded electronic control systems includes requirements development and verification of software in a bench environment as well as troubleshooting software or system defects. * Set-up and configuration of test bench hardware & software.

**Software Integration**

* Integrate software components, libraries, and auto-generated code into deployable software images and flash files.
* Configure and manage software builds using embedded development toolchains.
* Integrate calibration, configuration, and parameter datasets into embedded control applications.

**Verification & Validation**

**Defect Analysis & Troubleshooting**

* Identify, investigate, and resolve software defects and system integration issues.
* Perform root cause analysis of software, controls, and system-level failures.
* Utilize debugging and diagnostic tools to troubleshoot embedded applications.
* Support field issue resolution and continuous software improvement initiatives.

* Typically 6+ years of Salesforce development experience

* Translate regulatory and internal control requirements into enforceable technical controls for logging, data residency, TLS inspection scope, and lawful intercept considerations
* Normalise telemetry from security platforms into SIEM with regional data handling rules, and build detections for cross-border anomalies, DDoS events, and policy drift
* Lead L3/L4 incidents, coordinate issue containment, and drive RCAs with corrective actions codified
* Manage firewall, Zscaler, and Cloudflare policy through automation tools and vendor APIs, with CI/CD implementation including policy linting, unit tests, and path simulation

title: Sr Associate, MAPP Developer
description:
**ROLE SUMMARY**

Pfizer Digital & Technology is a customer-oriented, front-line organization with a vision to Win the Digital Race in Pharma and Unleash the Power of our Colleagues by creating compelling digital experiences for our internal and external audiences.

MAPP (My Anti-corruption Policy and Procedures) is Pfizer’s compliance platform designed to uphold the company’s commitment to ethical business practices and adherence to global anti-bribery and anti-corruption laws. The MAPP solution provides a centralized digital framework for managing, documenting, and approving interactions with healthcare professionals (HCPs), government officials, and third-party entities across global markets. The solution is a cornerstone of Pfizer’s compliance infrastructure, ensuring that all business activities are conducted with integrity and transparency.

In this role, you will be responsible for developing, testing, and supporting robust, scalable, and secure Appian applications that support critical business processes across the enterprise. This role serves as an experienced hands-on Appian developer, delivering solutions that align with enterprise standards, performance expectations, and security frameworks under the guidance of the Pfizer development lead. This role partners closely with Product Owners, Security, and cross‑functional Agile teams to deliver high‑quality applications, integrations, and reusable components.

The position requires solid, hands-on proficiency in Appian platform capabilities—including process models, interfaces, rules, data design, integrations, and modern low‑code patterns—and sound judgment in applying established best practices to create maintainable, future‑proof solutions. In addition to hands‑on development, this role contributes to design discussions, and stays current with new Appian features and industry trends to support continuous improvement

In this role, you will need to work collaboratively with individuals across teams and functions to achieve the business outcomes.

**ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Collaborate with product owners, analysts, and senior developers to **gather and refine requirements**, and help convert them into technical scope, user stories, and acceptance criteria
* Identify **integration touchpoints and dependencies** (APIs, data sources), and contribute to effort estimates and sprint planning.
* **Contribute to the design of end‑to‑end Appian solutions** (data model/CDTs & Records, SAIL UX, process models, security model) with guidance from senior developers, aligned to best practices and enterprise standards.
* Implement integrations (REST/SOAP, RDBMS, third‑party connectors) following documented **design patterns and performance considerations**.
* Implement Appian components: **SAIL interfaces, process models, rules/expressions, Records, CDTs, Web APIs, reports, and integrations**
* Apply **code standards, reuse strategies, and design patterns**; participate in peer reviews during sprints and support Associate-level team members
* Optimize during development for **UX and performance** (efficient queries, orchestration, paging, caching, responsive UIs)
* Perform **unit testing and code reviews**; validate security roles and data access; fix defects proactively.
* Assist with **performance tuning and troubleshooting** using logs, performance dashboards, and Appian Health Check prior to release
* **Support packaging and promotion of** applications across environments with Appian deployment tooling/Admin Console; contribute to release notes and rollback plans
* Support release coordination with QA/DevOps and stakeholders; ensure compliance with **quality and security gates** in Agile increments.
* **Stabilize and support** post‑go‑live: monitor, triage, resolve incidents; perform root‑cause analysis and deliver hotfixes.
* Contribute to **continuous improvement**: adopt new Appian features, help refine reusable components, and share knowledge with Associate team members.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**

* **Bachelor’s degree** in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field
* **3 years of development experience**, with at least 1 year of **hands-on Appian development experience** including SAIL, process models, records, reports, integrations, and interfaces
* Working knowledge of **Appian plug-ins**, **Appian Web APIs**, **data stores**, and **Appian object management**
* Experience building **workflow automations** and contributing to **enterprise-scale Appian applications**
* Proficiency in **RESTful API integration**, **JSON/XML**, and working with relational databases (SQL)
* Solid understanding of **software development lifecycle (SDLC)** and Agile delivery methodologies
* Ability to translate business requirements into scalable Appian solutions with **strong analytical and problem‑solving skills**
* Excellent communication skills with experience collaborating across **cross‑functional teams**, architects, and business stakeholders
* Foundational understanding of **Appian architecture concepts**, including performance tuning, scalability, and object governance

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* **Appian Certified Associate Developer (ACAD)** certification preferred; progress toward Appian Certified Senior Developer is a plus
* Exposure to **CI/CD pipelines**, DevOps practices, and Appian’s deployment automation tools
* Familiarity with **Process Mining**, AI-enabled workflows, and low-code automation strategies
* Good understanding of **data modeling**, relational databases, and enterprise data architectures

* Troubleshoot programming, tooling, and machining-related issues independently.

* Strong practical experience in manual VMC programming.
* Knowledge of G-code and M-code programming.
* Experience with HARCO, WINMAX, or FANUC control systems preferred.
* Good knowledge of milling operations, cutting tools, and cutting parameters.
* Understanding of tool selection, tool offsets, work offsets, and machining sequences.
* Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings.
* Knowledge of GD&T and precision measuring instruments.
* Ability to independently manage machining jobs and resolve technical issues.

**Educational Qualification**

* Diploma or B.E. in Mechanical Engineering preferred.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

The Senior Software Engineer contributes to design, development and deployment of Caterpillar’s state-of-the-art digital platform. This position will build a world class platform to host a wide range of digital applications.

**JOB DUTIES:** Responsibilities of the incumbents are across functional lines with individuals assigned in new program development and/or maintenance of existing mobile, WEB, Cloud, server, and/or distributed computing systems.

* Competent to perform all programming, project management, and development assignments without close supervision; normally assigned the more complex aspects of systems work.

* Works independently on complex systems or infrastructure components that may be used by one or more applications or systems.
* Drives application development focused around delivering business valuable features
* Mentor and assist software engineers, providing technical assistance and direction as needed
* Maintains high standards of software quality within the team by establishing good practices and habits Identifies and encourage areas for growth and improvement within the team
* Guide the team to develop a structured application/interface code, new program documentation, operations documentation and user guides in a casual, flexible environment
* Communicate with end users and internal customers to help direct development, debugging, and testing of application software for accuracy, integrity, interoperability, and completeness
* Performs integrated testing and customer acceptance testing of components that requires careful planning and execution to ensure timely, quality results.
* Employee is also responsible for performing other job duties as assigned by Caterpillar management from time to time.
* Manages the completion of its own work assignments and coordinates work with others. Based on past experiences and knowledge, the incumbent normally works independently with minimal management input and review of end results.
* Typical customers include Caterpillar customers, dealers, other external companies who purchase services offered by Caterpillar as well as internal business unit and/or service center groups.
* The position is challenged to quickly and correctly identify problems that may not be obvious. The incumbent solves problems by determining the best course of action, within departmental guidelines, from many existing solutions.

* Three years or more of experience in designing and developing software applications in ReactJS

title: C++ Architect
description:
**Career Area:**

Engineering

**Job Description:**

**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Role Definition  
Leads the design, development, testing, and architectural oversight of safety‑critical autonomy applications; collaborates with cross‑functional teams to meet internal and external needs.

Responsibilities  

* Designing safety‑critical features end‑to‑end — translating requirements into technical designs for sensor data processing, object detection, threat assessment, and automated safety responses
* Guiding teams on real‑time embedded software design practices, ensuring components are modular, testable, and maintainable.
* Documenting architecture specifications, software design descriptions, verification plans, test cases, operating procedures, and safety procedures.
* Supporting developers in building and validating detection and decision‑making algorithms across multiple vehicle and machine configurations
* Utilizing appropriate tools to debug, test, and maintain software and hardware systems, leading verification and validation activities.
* Lead design and code reviews with focus on safety, correctness, numerical stability, and handling of degraded or missing data

Degree Requirement  

* Requires a degree in Electronic/Electrical Engineering or Computer Science curriculum.
* More than 10 years of relevant industry experience in developing C++ applications

Skill Descriptors

Real‑Time Systems Integration
  
Knowledge of real‑time system architecture and multi‑system integration across sensing, compute, and actuation domains.
  
Level Working Knowledge:  

* Designs and validates end‑to‑end data flows meeting real‑time latency and throughput requirements.
* Integrates software across CAN, Ethernet, and middleware in multi‑ECU architectures.
* Diagnoses timing, synchronization, and data‑consistency issues in distributed systems.
* Defines interface contracts including schemas, timing budgets, and failure modes.
* Evaluates system‑level trade‑offs between compute load, bandwidth, and safety margins.

Artificial Intelligence & Sensor Fusion
  
Knowledge of AI and sensor fusion concepts and methods, with awareness of applicable industry standards and safety expectations; ability to develop and apply perception and prediction algorithms for autonomous systems.
  
Level Working Knowledge:  

* Designs and implements sensor fusion pipelines integrating radar, camera, and lidar data into a unified world model.
* Develops and tunes object detection, tracking, and prediction algorithms for real‑time autonomous decision‑making in safety‑critical contexts.
* Evaluates trade‑offs between algorithmic accuracy, latency, computational cost, and system‑level safety constraints on embedded platforms.
* Applies probabilistic and statistical techniques to noisy sensor data, accounting for uncertainty and failure modes.
* Supports validation of perception and prediction systems against ground truth, field data, and applicable standards or guidelines.
* Mentors others on integrating AI/ML components into safety‑critical software architectures.

Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)
  
Knowledge of SDLC methodologies with ability to deliver, validate, and manage high‑quality software products.
  
Level Working Knowledge:  

* Applies multiple vendor‑provided or in‑house SDLC methodologies with testing embedded across all phases.
* Converts requirements into robust, reviewable designs with explicit verification and testability considerations.
* Leads activities across all SDLC phases including design, implementation, integration, testing, validation, and release.
* Defines and executes test strategies, plans, and cases to validate functionality, error handling, reliability, and failure modes.
* Evaluates and consults on effective SDLC and testing practices using iterative and agile approaches.

Software Development  
Knowledge of programming languages, tools, and Linux‑based development; ability to design, implement, debug, and maintain software for embedded and distributed systems.
  
Level Working Knowledge:  

* Designs and develops software on Linux platforms, including embedded and system‑level components.
* Applies modern C++ (C++11/14/17), including concurrency, RAII, smart pointers, and memory‑safe patterns, in Linux environments.
* Uses Linux debugging and profiling tools to diagnose functional and performance issues.
* Oversees large development efforts aligned with system and architectural design.
* Evaluates programming trade‑offs across performance, memory, safety, and maintainability.
* Coaches junior engineers on programming best practices and Linux workflows.

Problem Solving & Technical Troubleshooting
  
Knowledge of structured problem‑solving methods and advanced troubleshooting techniques across organizational, hardware, software, and system domains; ability to resolve high‑impact issues.
  
Level Working Knowledge:  

* Leads structured problem resolution and root‑cause analysis for complex, high‑impact issues.
* Analyzes complex technical problems and applies appropriate diagnostic techniques based on context and impact.
* Resolves critical or wide‑impact hardware, software, and communication failures.
* Drives urgency, prioritization, and decision‑making based on business impact.
* Directs cross‑team and multi‑vendor issue resolution and coach others on advanced troubleshooting techniques.

Additional Information  
This position requires working onsite five days a week.

title: Senior Software Engineer I
description:
**Senior Software Engineer I**

  

**Do you enjoy building modern software solutions using a diverse technology stack?**

  

**Do you enjoy mentoring colleagues, sharing knowledge, and contributing to a collaborative, high-performing engineering team?**

  

**About the Business**

LexisNexis Risk Solutions is the essential partner in the assessment of risk. Within our Business Services vertical, we offer a multitude of solutions focused on helping businesses of all sizes drive higher revenue growth, maximize operational efficiencies, and improve customer experience. Our solutions help our customers solve difficult problems in the areas of Anti-Money Laundering/Counter Terrorist Financing, Identity Authentication & Verification, Fraud and Credit Risk mitigation and Customer Data Management. You can learn more about LexisNexis Risk at https://risk.lexisnexis.com/

**About the Team:**

Team is tech hub for rest of the organization and hence working across multiple domains – US Healthcare, Insurance, Government etc. Team primarily works on data extraction, manipulation, loading, and analytics using technologies like Python, PySpark, Bigdata – HPCC, language ECL, Talend, Azure tools (Data Synapse, ADF etc), Power BI, Essbase, OCI, etc.

  

**About the Role**

We are seeking a **Data Platform Operations & Observability Engineer** to enhance and support our analytics platform across on-premises and Azure environments. This role requires reliable support for on-premises and Azure analytics platforms through pipeline monitoring, incident resolution, automation, and observability improvements. The role requires strong Python, SQL, cloud, data engineering, monitoring, troubleshooting, and maintaining data pipelines and platform services. The engineer will investigate production issues, restore failed processes, communicate with stakeholders, and help improve platform reliability. Over time, the engineer will also build and enhance monitoring, alerting, logging, dashboards, and operational processes to improve observability and reduce incidents.

  

**Responsibilities**

**Operations & Support**

* Monitor and support production data pipelines and analytics platforms and Identify opportunities to improve reliability, performance, and operational efficiency.
* Troubleshoot pipeline failures, data issues, application errors, and performance problems, data movement across on-premises and cloud environments.
* Perform root cause analysis and implement corrective actions and Communicate incidents, remediation plans, and service impacts to stakeholders.
* Support Python automation processes, scheduled jobs, and file transfer workflows. Administer Windows servers, including patching, software installation, vulnerability remediation, and system maintenance.
* Support Azure services including Databricks, Data Factory, Synapse, and Data Lake Storage. Create and maintain operational documentation, diagrams, and support procedures.
  

**Observability & Reliability**

* Design and maintain monitoring, alerting, and dashboard solutions. Build and maintain centralized logging and operational reporting.
* Define and track operational metrics, KPIs, SLAs, and SLOs and develop proactive monitoring to detect issues before they affect users.
* Automate operational tasks and repetitive support activities drive continuous improvements in platform reliability and observability.
  

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Strong Python development and troubleshooting skills with Pyspark also expected with Observability is considered the key requirement, including logging, monitoring, dashboard creation from logs, alerting, debugging, and performance analysis.
* Have relevant experience in cloud logging tools such as Grafana and Elasticsearch/Kibana, Azure Log Analytics Workspace and Amazon CloudWatch Logs.
* Experience working with Azure or other cloud platforms also and using common data formats such as CSV, JSON, XML, and Parquet.
* Experience administering Windows Server environments, Knowledge of data integration concepts, file transfers, APIs, and data validation. Understanding of networking fundamentals including DNS, proxies, firewalls, VPNs, and SSL/TLS.
* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills, verbal, and written communication skills with ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment, Self-motivated, detail-oriented, and eager to learn.
  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* **Scheduling tools:** Control-M, AutoSys, Airflow, Windows Task Scheduler, and Job Scheduler were discussed. Experience with these would be beneficial.
* **Nice-to-have experience:** Databricks and Azure Data Factory experience are not mandatory but would be beneficial.
* Preferrable from NOC/networking, administration, development, or data-engineering backgrounds who have moved toward Python and observability-oriented work.
  

**Our Commitment to Inclusion**

We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, including underrepresented groups, people with disabilities, career changers, and candidates with non-traditional education or experience. If you require accommodations at any stage of the recruitment process, please let us know. We are committed to supporting your success.

title: Lead Software Engineer
description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

**Business / Organization Overview**
====================================

We are looking for a high-caliber **Senior Java Technical Lead / Architect (C13)** to spearhead the architecture, engineering strategy, and technical delivery of enterprise-scale distributed platforms. In this strategic technical leadership position, you will govern large-scale engineering initiatives, drive cloud-native modernization, set foundational architecture patterns, and mentor multiple agile engineering squads across globally distributed teams.

**Role Summary**
================

At the **C13 grade**, you will operate as a subject matter expert and technical authority combining deep architectural mastery with strategic delivery oversight. You will lead end-to-end design, technology evaluation, security governance, and multi-system integration across distributed microservices, high-throughput event streaming, enterprise databases, and container platforms. You will partner with Directors, Enterprise Architects, Product Managers, and Business Leaders to ensure technology roadmaps align with business transformation objectives.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**Strategic Architecture & System Design**
------------------------------------------

* Own end-to-end technical architecture, system decomposition, and integration strategy for complex, multi-tiered enterprise systems.

* Define architectural blueprints, domain models, and technical design standards for high-throughput, low-latency, and highly available microservices.

* Lead technology evaluation, Proof of Concepts (PoCs), and modernization roadmaps (e.g., legacy monolith/WebSphere decomposition to cloud-native microservices and event-driven architectures).

* Formally represent the application in Enterprise Architecture Governance, Security Reviews, and Technology Risk committees.

**Technical Governance & Engineering Leadership**
-------------------------------------------------

* Provide technical leadership and architectural oversight across multiple development teams and technical leads (C11/C12).

* Enforce rigorous engineering standards, Clean Code practices, comprehensive automated testing (TDD/BDD), and robust CI/CD DevOps pipelines.

* Establish standards for non-functional requirements (NFRs) including system resilience, fault tolerance, high availability (HA), Disaster Recovery (DR), low latency, and horizontal scalability.

* Drive modernization of messaging pipelines, event stream topologies, and polyglot persistence layers.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration & Stakeholder Management**
-----------------------------------------------------------

* Partner closely with Product Owners, Program Managers, and Executive Stakeholders to translate multi-year business strategies into actionable, phased technical roadmaps.

* Manage architectural risks, technical debt remediation, and capacity planning.

title: Database Developer
description:
**Job Title:** Database Developer

**Job Summary**

We are looking for a skilled Database Developer with strong expertise in SQL development, database design, query optimization, and data management. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience developing database objects, optimizing query performance, designing scalable database structures, and supporting data migration and integration activities.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Database Design and Architecture**

* Design and develop database schemas, tables, indexes, and relationships.
* Apply database normalization techniques to minimize data redundancy.
* Design scalable and efficient database structures.
* Document database models and architecture.

**2. SQL Development**

* Develop and maintain stored procedures, functions, triggers, and views.
* Write complex SQL queries using joins, subqueries, aggregations, and other advanced SQL features.
* Optimize SQL queries to improve performance and efficiency.
* Implement constraints and validation rules to maintain data integrity.

**3. Database Performance Optimization**

* Identify and resolve database performance bottlenecks.
* Create and maintain indexes for efficient query execution.
* Analyze execution plans and perform query tuning.
* Monitor database resource utilization, including CPU, memory, and I/O.

**4. Data Migration and ETL**

* Perform data migration between databases and systems.
* Develop and maintain ETL processes and data transformation workflows.
* Cleanse, transform, and validate data.
* Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and quality.

**5. Database Maintenance and Support**

* Support database backup and recovery activities.
* Monitor database health, availability, and performance.
* Apply database patches and updates as required.
* Manage database capacity planning and access controls.
* Troubleshoot and resolve production database issues.

**6. Security and Compliance**

* Implement database security measures, access controls, and encryption.
* Monitor and audit database access.
* Ensure appropriate handling of sensitive data and compliance with applicable regulations.

**7. Testing and Quality Assurance**

* Perform unit testing of database objects, procedures, and functions.
* Validate data integrity and consistency.
* Conduct performance testing for queries and database procedures.
* Collaborate with QA teams to support testing activities.

**8. Version Control and Deployment**

* Maintain database scripts using version control tools such as Git.
* Manage database schema changes across development, testing, and production environments.
* Support database deployments and migration processes.
* Follow database change management and deployment best practices.

**9. Monitoring and Reporting**

* Configure database monitoring and alerting mechanisms.
* Track database performance metrics and identify improvement opportunities.
* Develop database reports and operational dashboards as required.

Required Technical Skills

* Strong proficiency in SQL, including complex queries and query optimization.
* Hands-on experience with PostgreSQL, SQL Server, Oracle, MySQL, or similar relational databases.
* Experience developing stored procedures, functions, triggers, and views.
* Strong understanding of database design, normalization, indexing, and relational data modeling.
* Experience in performance tuning and execution plan analysis.
* Knowledge of ETL processes, data migration, and data validation.
* Familiarity with Git and database version control practices.
* Understanding of database security, backup, and recovery concepts.
* Exposure to cloud database services such as AWS RDS or Azure SQL is an advantage.

Preferred Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to collaborate with application developers, QA teams, and other technical stakeholders.
* Good documentation and communication skills.

**Note:** We are looking for a hands-on Database Developer with strong SQL development and database engineering skills, rather than a profile focused exclusively on database administration.

title: Software Engineer in Test
description:
**Job Description: V&V Tech Lead**
==================================

**Job Summary:** Caterpillar Trimble Control Technologies (CTCT) is a joint venture between Caterpillar and Trimble whose purpose is to transform the way heavy equipment customers shape the world with solutions that differentiate Caterpillar and Trimble.

As a V&V Tech Lead for CTCT grade control platform products, you will own the full verification and validation (V&V) lifecycle for your dedicated product team. Reporting through the validation organization, your primary objective is to ensure products meet end-user quality expectations by strategically shifting validation activities earlier in the development cycle using an end-to-end methodology. You will plan, direct, and execute these activities by leveraging team expertise, world-class evaluation methods, and enterprise best practices. Ultimately, your leadership will ensure that technical and program risks are accurately identified and quantified, and that all validation test plans are thorough, well-documented, and efficiently executed.

**Job Duties & Responsibilities:**

**Product Strategy & Alignment**

* **Customer & Feature Alignment:** Collaborate directly with Product Owners to deeply understand product features, customer expectations, and ensure solutions are intuitive and user-friendly.
* **Cross-Functional Bridge:** Act as the vital link between Product and Development teams, translating feature requirements into clear, robust acceptance criteria and actionable V&V goals.
* **Lifecycle Ownership:** Fully understand the functionality and application of platform products, following them through their full lifecycle—from early development up to product deprecation.
* **Feature Risk Assessment:** Proactively identify and assess risks associated with specific features and functionalities, participating heavily in the product risk assessment process to ensure "Testing with a Purpose."

**Process & V&V Strategy**

* **Test Pyramid Optimization:** Drive the overarching test strategy by mapping product functionalities to the software development lifecycle (SDLC). Push testing to the bottom of the test pyramid for earlier detection.
* **Multi-Layered Coverage:** Architect a comprehensive validation strategy spanning from low-level Component Test Specification (CTS) coverage, through the Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) layer, up to final physical machine testing.
* **Software Performance Validation:** Proactively strategize, monitor, and validate against critical software failure modes, specifically focusing on system performance metrics like network bus loads and CPU loads.
* **V&V Best Practices:** Establish and enforce standard V&V processes, including rigorous test plan and result reviews, effective machine-test time planning, design margin testing, and driving exploratory testing initiatives.
* **Standardized Documentation & Training:** Drive the use of Design Verification Plan & Report (DVP&R) and Risk-Based Thinking. Educate product teams and mentor validation engineers on key processes, venues, and validation expectations.

**Tools & Environments**

* **HIL Simulation & Execution:** Execute and oversee complex Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) validation using tools such as dSPACE (harnessing, modeling, and execution), Vector tools, Simulink, and Stateflow.
* **API & Automation Frameworks:** Design, develop, and maintain automated API verification frameworks using modern testing tools like Playwright and Postman.
* **Next-Gen QA & AI:** Leverage AI agentic QA tools and extensive automation experience to drive continuous improvement, speed, and efficiency in the software validation pipeline.
* **Innovative Machine Simulation:** Innovate and develop new, effective ways to simulate complex machine setups in lab environments to supplement and enhance physical testing.
* **Hands-On Machine & Environmental Testing:** Apply hands-on machine testing experience to practically evaluate product performance in real-world environments, alongside executing environmental and performance lab tests.

**How to Apply:** Please submit an online application for this position by clicking on one of the Apply buttons located in this posting.

**Join a Values-Driven Team: Belong, Grow, Innovate.**

At Trimble, our core values of Belong, Grow, and Innovate aren't just words—they're the foundation of our culture. We foster an environment where you are seen, heard, and valued (Belong); where you have an opportunity to build a career and drive our collective growth (Grow); and where your innovative ideas shape the future (Innovate). We believe in empowering local teams to create impactful strategies, ensuring our global vision resonates with every individual. Become part of a team where your contributions truly matter.

title: Java Developer
description:
**Job Description:**
====================

**Key Responsibilities**

* Document and implement robust Java-based eCommerce platforms, storefront services, and headless APIs for digital experiences.
* Lead design and implementation of microservices for customer journeys such as search, browse, cart, checkout, and personalization.
* Experience designing, configuring and supporting RDBMS solutions in Azure Cloud.
* Work closely with Product Managers, UI/UX teams, and DevOps engineers to ensure seamless end-to-end customer experiences.
* Integrate with key systems like PIM, OMS, CRM, payment gateways, and third-party personalization engines.
* Design and implement component integration solutions using message brokers such as AMQP based messaging solutions such as RabbitMQ, Azure Service Bus for real-time data processing, order events, customer activity tracking, etc.
* Support cloud-native deployments on Azure, AWS or GCP ensuring scalability, availability, and security.
* Drive performance tuning, caching strategies (Hazelcast, Redis), and low-latency API designs for high traffic storefronts.
* Provide technical leadership across squads, mentor engineers, and enforce best practices around DevSecOps and CI/CD.
* Ensure observability requirements are defined and met using tools such as Datadog and Splunk.
* Stay abreast of the latest in commerce tech, MACH architecture, and GenAI innovations relevant to digital commerce, including agentic AI for developer productivity.

**Must-Have Skills**

* **Core Tech:** Java 11+ (preferably Java 17 or 21), Spring Boot, J2EE, RESTful APIs
* **Architecture:** Microservices, Design Patterns
* **Cloud:** Hands-on experience with Azure(preferred)/ AWS / GCP (2+ years; certification preferred)
* **Databases:** Postgres/Oracle/DB2/SQL, SQL tuning

* **Full-cycle exposure to SDLC stages**: requirements, development, testing, deployment and on-going operations
* Understanding of DevSecOps practices and eCommerce-specific security concerns (PCI DSS, OWASP)
* **Domain Expertise:** Experience in digital commerce
* **Messaging & Integration:** Messaging queue or streaming tools for backend-to-frontend event correlation and third-party integrations
* **Agile Leadership:** Strong understanding of Scrum, backlog grooming, iteration planning, technical sizing
* Experience with agentic coding tools (e.g., OpenCode, ClaudeCode, or equivalent) for accelerating Java development, test automation, and CI/CD workflows.
* **Customer-Centric Mindset:** Ability to build as well as verify secure, fast, and intuitive systems for high engagement and conversion

**Nice-to-Have Skills**

* Experience with **Domain-Driven Design**.
* Front-end familiarity with React (especially for headless commerce architectures)
* Experience with application performance monitoring and distributed log tools (New Relic, Datadog, Splunk)
* Previous work with GenAI tools like GitHub Copilot or Amazon Q Developer
* Experience with data governance including controlling access to PII.
* RFP and pre-sales solution design experience for digital commerce platforms
* Design and implement solutions that externalized business rules in dedicated testable business rules engine
* Evaluate and integrate third-party APIs, legacy systems (.NET, IBM iSeries), REST and GraphQL services.
* Knowledge of infrastructure-as-code solutions such as Terraform.
* Understanding of product catalog and session management at scale

**Preferred Certifications**

* **Java / Spring Certification**
* **eCommerce platform certifications** (SAP Commerce Cloud, Salesforce Commerce Cloud, Adobe Commerce/Magento – a plus)

**Education**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.

title: Software Development & Engineer 2
description:
Comcast brings together the best in media and technology. We drive innovation to create the world's best entertainment and online experiences. As a Fortune 50 leader, we set the pace in a variety of innovative and fascinating businesses and create career opportunities across a wide range of locations and disciplines. We are at the forefront of change and move at an amazing pace, thanks to our remarkable people, who bring cutting-edge products and services to life for millions of customers every day. If you share in our passion for teamwork, our vision to revolutionize industries and our goal to lead the future in media and technology, we want you to fast-forward your career at Comcast.

**Job Summary**

This job entails writing and maintaining clean, efficient code for various software components while following development best practices. It supports the design and innovation of new applications that align with business goals. It involves implementing testing frameworks to validate software, documenting development processes for knowledge transfer, and analyzing integration needs. Responsibilities also include collaborating with Quality Assurance to meet technical standards, and troubleshooting to improve performance and user satisfaction.

**Job Description**

**Responsibilities:**

* Writing and maintaining efficient code for software components, adhering to best practices in development
* Supporting the design and development of new software applications aligned with business objectives
* Implementing testing frameworks for software validation, including unit and integration tests, to ensure quality
* Documenting the software development process, including design and deployment procedures, to facilitate knowledge sharing
* Analyzing software integration needs and planning system architecture to meet technical specifications
* Reviewing current practices and technical literature to inform project solutions and applying engineering methodologies
* Working with Quality Assurance to ensure applications meet technical requirements and fit specifications
* Troubleshooting software issues, providing resolutions to enhance application performance and user satisfaction
* Consistent exercise of independent judgment and discretion in matters of significance.
* Regular, consistent and punctual attendance. Must be able to work nights and weekends, variable schedule(s) as necessary.
* Other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

**Must have skills**

* Performance & scalability design,
* Strong SQL/PLSQL, query writing, and hands-on with Oracle/SQL Server/MySQL
* Analyze execution plans, optimize queries, monitor DB health
* Security architecture (secrets management with Vault),
* Design patterns (Repository, Service, existing codebase patterns)
* SonarQube (code quality, resolving code smells & vulnerabilities)
* AI-assisted development - GitHub Copilot, prompt engineering for code generation
* Java enterprise architecture (Spring ecosystem, WAR-based deployments),
* REST API design,
* Angular + TypeScript, Jest, ReactJS, Redux
* HTML / CSS / SCSS
* Multi-module Maven project architecture,
* Oracle DB schema design & optimization,
* Authentication/Authorization architecture (Spring Security, OAuth2/SSO),
* Integration patterns (REST, WebSocket/STOMP, SFTP, scheduled jobs),
* Deployment architecture (Tomcat, Apache),

**Good to have skills:**

* Spec-driven architecture
* Building custom AI agents / RAG pipelines
* Monitoring & observability (Splunk, Grafana, Prometheus)
* Security scanning (Snyk)

**Employees at all levels are expected to:**

* Understand our Operating Principles; make them the guidelines for how you do your job.
* Own the customer experience think and act in ways that put our customers first, give them seamless digital options at every touchpoint, and make them promoters of our products and services.
* Know your stuff be enthusiastic learners, users and advocates of our game-changing technology, products and services, especially our digital tools and experiences.
* Win as a team make big things happen by working together and being open to new ideas.
* Be an active part of the Net Promoter System a way of working that brings more employee and customer feedback into the company by joining huddles, making call backs and helping us elevate opportunities to do better for our customers.
* Drive results and growth.
* Support a culture of inclusion in how you work and lead.
* Do what's right for each other, our customers, investors and our communities.

**Disclaimer:** This information has been designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by employees in this role. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities and qualifications.

Comcast is an equal opportunity workplace. We will consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

Base pay is one part of the Total Rewards that Comcast provides to compensate and recognize employees for their work. Most sales positions are eligible for a Commission under the terms of an applicable plan, while most non-sales positions are eligible for a Bonus. Additionally, Comcast provides best-in-class Benefits to eligible employees. We believe that benefits should connect you to the support you need when it matters most, and should help you care for those who matter most. That’s why we provide an array of options, expert guidance and always-on tools, that are personalized to meet the needs of your reality - to help support you physically, financially and emotionally through the big milestones and in your everyday life. Please visit the compensation and benefits summary on our careers site for more details.

Bachelor's Degree

2-5 Years

description:

Osez-vous regarder les défis mondiaux et y voir des opportunités porteuses d’impact ? Souhaitez-vous contribuer à bâtir un avenir meilleur ? Si la réponse est oui, nous vous invitons à envisager de nous rejoindre pour repousser les limites du possible en faveur d’un monde durable.

Découvrez nosavantagesconçu pour vous permettre de vous épanouir au travail comme à la maison.

Nous avançons avec audace.

**Où se trouve le travail :**

Du lundi au jeudi, travaillez sur site avec vos collègues. Le vendredi, choisissez votre lieu de travail, en tenant compte des exigences de votre activité.  

**What's in it for you:**
  
The Manager, Embedded Controls Software Development leads a team responsible for the architecture, design, development, integration, and support of embedded controls software for product and platform applications. This role provides both technical and people leadership, ensuring delivery of reliable, scalable, and high-quality software solutions that support product performance, connectivity, and customer value

This leader partners closely with cross-functional teams across systems, Application, firmware, test, quality, product management, and program management to drive execution from concept through launch and ongoing support. The ideal candidate brings strong expertise in embedded systems, hands-on software development in C/C++ and Rust, and experience with embedded communication protocols.

  
  

**What you will do:**

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of software engineers focused on embedded controls development.
* Drive planning, prioritization, and execution of software deliverables across multiple projects and product initiatives.
* Provide technical leadership in software architecture, design, coding, debugging, integration, and validation activities.
* Guide design reviews, code reviews, and technical decision-making to ensure robust and maintainable solutions.
* Partner with cross-functional engineering and business teams to align technical execution with product requirements, quality expectations, cost targets, and project timelines.
* Support definition of project scope, schedules, resource needs, and risk mitigation strategies.
* Drive issue resolution through structured problem-solving, root cause analysis, and corrective action.
* Promote best practices in software development, coding standards, documentation, version control, and defect management.
* Support continuous improvement in development processes, software quality, team effectiveness, and delivery performance.
* Build organizational capability through performance management, coaching, feedback, and development planning.
* Ensure compliance with applicable development processes, quality requirements, cybersecurity expectations, and regulatory standards.

  

**What you will bring:**

* **Required Qualifications**
  ---------------------------

  + Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.
  + 15+ years of experience in embedded software or controls software development.
  + Strong programming experience in C/C++ and Rust.
  + Experience with embedded systems development, troubleshooting, and debugging.
  + Experience with embedded communication protocols such as CAN, UART, SPI, I2C, Modbus, BACnet, or similar.
  + Demonstrated experience leading engineering teams, major technical workstreams, or complex software projects.
  + Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  + Ability to collaborate effectively across cross-functional teams and influence technical direction.
* **Preferred Qualifications**
  ----------------------------

  + Direct people leadership or engineering management experience.
  + Experience in HVAC controls, building automation, industrial automation, or related embedded product environments.
  + Familiarity with real-time operating systems (RTOS) and microcontroller-based software development.
  + Experience with software architecture, control algorithm implementation, and hardware/software integration.
  + Knowledge of unit testing, integration testing, and system validation practices.
  + Experience with agile development methodologies, continuous integration, and modern software development tools.
  + Familiarity with cybersecurity requirements for connected embedded devices.
  + Master’s degree in a related technical or business discipline.
* **Leadership Expectations**
  ---------------------------

  + Create an inclusive, accountable, and high-performing team environment.

title: Mainframe CICS Systems Programmer
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

**Your Role**

  

As a System Administrator at Kyndryl, you’ll solve complex problems and identify potential future issues across the spectrum of platforms and services. You’ll be at the forefront of new technology and modernization, working with some of our biggest clients – which means some of the biggest in the world.
  
  
There’s never a typical day as a System Administrator at Kyndryl, because no two projects are alike. You’ll be managing systems data for clients and providing day-to-day solutions and security compliance. You’ll oversee a queue of assignments and work directly with technicians, prioritizing tickets to deliver the best solutions to our clients.

  

**What You Will Do**

  

* Install, configure, and maintain CICS environments.
* Manage CICSplex infrastructure.
* Support transaction processing environments.
* Troubleshoot availability and performance issues.
* Support upgrades and migrations.
* Ensure resiliency and disaster recovery readiness.
Integrate CICS with DB2, MQ, RACF, and z/OS services.  

  

One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here. You’ll also get the chance to share your expertise by recommending modernization options, identifying new business opportunities, and cultivating relationships with other teams and stakeholders. Does the work get challenging at times? Yes! But you’ll collaborate with a diverse group of talented people and gain invaluable management and organizational skills, which will come in handy as you move forward in your career.

**Your Future at Kyndryl**

Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career, from Junior System Administrator to Architect. We have opportunities for Cloud Hyperscalers that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

  

### **Required Technical and Professional Expertise**

  

* 5 to 7 years of experience in IBM Mainframe technologies.
* Strong experience in IBM CICS Transaction Server (CICS TS) administration, including CICSPlex SM, CICS region management, and transaction processing.
* Expertise in CICS performance tuning, recovery management, diagnostics, dump analysis, and problem determination.
* Experience integrating CICS with IBM MQ, DB2, RACF, and z/OS subsystems.
* Knowledge of high-availability, workload management, and mission-critical transaction processing environments.
Experience with Microsoft Windows Server 2016/2019, VMware ESX, and public/private cloud environments, including on-premises to cloud migrations.  

  

### **Preferred Technical and Professional Experience**

  

* Experience with CICSPlex SM, CICS upgrades, migrations, maintenance, and release management.
* Knowledge of OMEGAMON for CICS, CICS Explorer, JCL, SMP/E, and REXX.
* Familiarity with Parallel Sysplex, workload balancing, disaster recovery, and resilience architectures.
* Understanding of ITIL Incident, Problem, and Change Management processes.
* Experience with automation, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), vulnerability management, Active Directory, and ADFS.
Strong troubleshooting, documentation, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

Citi is delighted to open applications for the Application Development and Software Engineering stream of its Reactivate Your Career Program. The Program is designed to help you transition from a career break into a career within financial services. You may have worked in the finance sector, the tech sector or another industry altogether!

Returners in the Application Development and Software Engineering stream, will have the opportunity to utilize their knowledge of applications development procedures and concepts, and basic knowledge of other technical areas to identify and define necessary system enhancements, including using script tools and analyzing/interpreting code.

We are interested in applications from those who have a range of experience including, but not limited to:

* **Experience:** A minimum of 4 years of professional experience in software development, with a significant focus on Python.

* **Python Expertise:**Strong understanding of Python and its ecosystem, including experience with common frameworks (e.g., Django, Flask, FastAPI) and libraries.

* **Kubernetes:**Hands-on experience with Kubernetes, including cluster management, application deployment (Helm charts), and monitoring.

* **Containers:** Proficient in containerization technologies, primarily Docker, including building optimized and secure container images.

* **Cloud Platforms:**Experience with at least one major cloud provider (AWS, GCP, Azure)

* **GenAI/****AgenticAI** **Development:** Exposure to GenAI/AgenticAI development, with a basic understanding of frameworks like TensorFlow, PyTorch, or scikit-learn

We value your knowledge, skills and experience, regardless of how and where you have developed them. We believe that hiring people from different backgrounds with an array of perspectives brings advantages to our teams and ultimately makes Citi a better place to work.

This supportive hiring programme will start inSeptember 2026 and you will benefit from a structured and in-depth induction to help you transition successfully back into the workplace, followed by a tailored programme of professional development and learning delivered over a period of 4 weeks.

You will enjoy the benefits of being part of a supportive cohort and will be paired with a buddy to assist with a smooth transition into life in Citi. Citi recognizes the importance of flexible working arrangements and is happy to explore these with you in line with local policy. Citi operates a hybrid working model for the majority of roles across the bank.

**Eligible candidates will....**

* Have been on a career break for at least **18 months**

* Have a minimum of 4 -5 years professional work experience in an Application Development / Software Engineering environment

* Be eligible to live and work in India

* Demonstrate natural curiosity and be motivated to learn new skills, with a proactive attitude toward new technologies and methodologies

* What interests you about joining the Reactivate Your Career Program and why now?

* Adhere to a schedule that efficiently manages resources and allows timely implementations.

* 8+ years of professional experience in Mainframe Storage Support
* Extensive skills with IBM storage software including IBM Copy Services Manager/Global Mirroring, SMS, HSM, IDCAMS, and DFDSS.
* Experience in preparing and implementing Disaster Recovery plans
* Expert knowledge of catalog structures, LPAR sysplexes, and resource sharing.
* Extensive knowledge of DASD hardware configurations incorporating replication.

Ability to work as part of a team, as well as independently.
