title: Lead Developer - Java and Microservices
description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

We are seeking a highly experienced and technically accomplished **Application Dev Lead** to join our team, responsible for architecting, developing, and leading our core banking integration strategies and modern microservices ecosystem. The ideal candidate will be a subject matter expert in integration technologies, possess deep, hands-on expertise in **Java Microservices and enterprise Database engineering (Oracle/SQL)**, have extensive knowledge of the financial services domain, and demonstrate a proven track record of leading technical teams to deliver robust, scalable, and secure solutions.

This role requires a unique blend of hands-on technical excellence, architectural vision, database performance optimization, and strong people management skills to drive the modernization and stability of our mission-critical banking systems.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Leadership & People Management**

* **Team Leadership & Mentorship:** Lead, manage, and mentor a high-performing team of developers, backend engineers, and integration specialists, fostering technical capability, career growth, and engineering excellence across Java microservices and middleware platforms.
* **Project & Delivery Ownership:** Take full ownership of technical delivery across complex integration initiatives, including architectural scoping, task breakdown (WBS), accurate sprint estimation, resource planning, and milestone prioritization.
* **Quality Assurance & Engineering Governance:** Enforce best-in-class engineering practices by conducting rigorous code reviews, pull request audits, and comprehensive architectural design reviews (TDRs).
* **Stakeholder Collaboration:** Collaborate seamlessly across business lines, enterprise architecture, database administrators, infrastructure, Information Security, and third-party vendor teams to align technical delivery with strategic business goals.
* **SME & Agile Delivery:** Act as the primary Subject Matter Expert (SME) for complex escalations, production incident triage (Sev-1/MIM), and root-cause analysis, while driving Agile/Scrum ceremonies to ensure predictable, high-quality, and timely delivery.

**Technical & Domain Responsibilities**

* **Java Microservices Architecture:** Architect, build, and deploy production-grade, containerized Java microservices using Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, and RESTful/gRPC APIs, implementing distributed resilience patterns (Saga orchestrations, Circuit Breakers, Bulkheads, Outbox pattern).
* **Database Engineering & Query Performance:** Design robust database models and persistence layers (Spring Data JPA, Hibernate, JDBC), execute query tuning, analyze execution plans (EXPLAIN PLAN), optimize indexing strategies (B-Tree, Bitmap, composite), and resolve connection pool (HikariCP) and row-level locking contentions in enterprise Oracle/SQL environments.
* **High-Availability Integration Design:** Design and implement resilient, distributed integration solutions prioritizing active-active high availability (HA), fault tolerance, multi-region disaster recovery (DR), recoverability, and minimal business disruption.
* **Legacy-to-Cloud Modernization:** Lead the architectural evolution and phased decomposition of legacy centralized middleware (TIBCO BusinessWorks, IBM MQ) into distributed, event-driven architectures utilizing Apache Kafka and cloud-native Java microservices.
* **Banking Domain Systems Integration:** Apply deep expertise in banking and financial services to integration architecture, specifically in real-time fraud detection, payment processing rails (ISO 20022, SWIFT, Fedwire, ACH), clearing and settlement, and core enterprise banking ledgers.
* **Security, Audit & Regulatory Compliance:** Ensure all integration services strictly comply with enterprise security baselines, audit controls, regulatory mandates (OCC, Fed, PRA, MAS), data protection rules (PII, PCI-DSS), Mutual TLS (mTLS) certificate management, and operational resilience standards.
* **High-Volume Real-Time Messaging:** Oversee the architecture, throughput tuning, and management of real-time transaction flows, high-volume messaging pipelines, dead-letter queue (DLQ) automation, and sub-second SLA routing.

**Recommended Qualifications**

**Core Technical Skills**

* **Java & Microservices:**
  + Advanced proficiency in Core Java (Java 11/17/21), Multithreading, Concurrency, and JVM tuning (Memory management, Garbage Collection - G1GC/ZGC).
  + Hands-on mastery of Spring Framework (Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Spring Data, Spring Security, Spring Batch).
  + Deep experience with Microservices patterns (Saga Orchestration/Choreography, CQRS, Circuit Breaker via Resilience4j, API Gateway routing).
  + Containerization and orchestration experience using Docker, Kubernetes, and OpenShift.
* **Database & Data Persistence:**
  + Advanced expertise in Relational Databases: Oracle (19c+), SQL, PL/SQL, stored procedures, functions, packages, and triggers.
  + Deep knowledge of Query Performance Tuning, Execution Plan analysis (EXPLAIN PLAN), index design, partitioning, and stats gathering.
  + Mastery of connection pool management (HikariCP), lock contention mitigation, deadlock resolution, and transaction isolation levels (**READ COMMITTED**, **SERIALIZABLE**).
  + Solid understanding of ORM frameworks (Hibernate, JPA) and mitigation of ORM antipatterns (**N+1** queries, dirty checks).
* **Enterprise Middleware & Messaging:**
  + Subject Matter Expertise in TIBCO technologies: TIBCO BusinessWorks (BW 5.x / 6.x), TIBCO Enterprise Message Service (EMS), TIBCO Administrator/TEA.
  + In-depth experience with enterprise queuing and streaming: IBM MQ and Apache Kafka (Topic design, Partitioning, Consumer Groups, Schema Registry).
* **APIs & Protocols:**
  + Contract-first API development: RESTful Web Services, OpenAPI/Swagger, SOAP Web Services, gRPC.
  + Data formatting & transformation: JSON, XML, XSD, WSDL, XPath, XSLT, and Canonical Data Modeling.
* **Security & Cryptography:**
  + Solid foundation in transport and application security: SSL/TLS 1.3, Mutual TLS (mTLS), Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), Keystores/Truststores, OAuth2, OIDC, SAML, and API Key/Token management.
* **DevOps, CI/CD & Observability:**
  + Build & CI/CD toolchains: Git, Maven, Gradle, Harness, TeamCity, Jenkins, uDeploy.
  + Comprehensive monitoring & logging: Splunk, AppDynamics, Dynatrace, Prometheus, Grafana, Micrometer, and distributed tracing (OpenTelemetry/Zipkin).

**Good to Have Skills**

* **Automated Testing & Quality Engineering:**
  + Experience with Test-Driven Development (TDD) and Behavior-Driven Development (BDD).
  + Familiarity with unit and integration testing frameworks such as JUnit 5, Mockito, Testcontainers, and Spring Boot Test.
  + Experience with API contract testing tools (Pact, Spring Cloud Contract) and performance/load testing tools (JMeter, Gatling).
  + Knowledge of automated code quality gates and static analysis tools (SonarQube, Checkstyle).

**Banking Domain Expertise**

* Deep expertise in banking and financial services integration architecture and enterprise application patterns.
* Proven experience with real-time fraud detection pipelines, payment processing rails (ISO 20022, SWIFT MT/MX, Fedwire, NACHA/ACH, RTP), core ledger accounting, and trade/transaction processing systems.
* In-depth knowledge of real-time transactional flows, straight-through processing (STP), guaranteed exactly-once delivery, idempotency key patterns, and high-volume messaging resilience.
* Hands-on familiarity with global banking regulations, audit readiness, operational resilience standards, and data protection frameworks (GLBA, GDPR, PCI-DSS).

**Leadership & Management**

* Demonstrated experience leading, mentoring, and managing technical teams of developers, backend engineers, and integration architects.
* Proven ability to manage full end-to-end technical delivery, including architectural roadmapping, scope definition, backlog grooming, estimation, and task prioritization.
* Track record of establishing engineering best practices, leading code reviews, reducing technical debt, and elevating team capabilities in modern technologies.
* Exceptional stakeholder management, technical communication, and presentation skills across technical teams and executive business sponsors.
* Strong proficiency in driving agile project delivery using Scrum/Kanban methodologies, sprint planning, and release governance.

title: Senior Software Development Engineer, Digital Payments and Emerging Markets
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

What if every customer around the world could pay for their order in the way that feels most natural to them? The Digital and Emerging Payments team at Amazon is working to make that happen, building payment experiences that work across geographies, platforms, and customer expectations. From Android and Fire devices to resilient back-end systems that guarantee no order is ever lost, the technical challenges here are real and the customer impact is global.  
  
We are looking for a Senior Software Development Engineer to help lead the technical direction of our payments platform. You will own the design and delivery of systems that process transactions at massive scale, mentor fellow engineers, and shape architectural decisions that determine how millions of customers complete their purchases. If you’re passionate about solving complex distributed systems challenges and want to make a direct impact on the customer experience, this could be the role for you.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Lead the design and delivery of payment platform features end-to-end, ensuring systems are reliable and performant across multiple geographies and device platforms.
* Own your team's architectural direction by evaluating technology choices, defining engineering best practices, and guiding future system design while balancing short-term delivery with long-term maintainability.
* Collaborate with product managers, partner engineering teams, and stakeholders across Amazon to define requirements, align on technical approaches, and deliver integrated solutions.
* Mentor engineers on your team through code reviews, design discussions, and hands-on guidance, raising the overall quality of the codebase.
* Use metrics and operational data to identify improvement opportunities, drive rapid iteration on features, and maintain high availability for payment systems.

  
A day in the life  
You review a design document for a new payment method integration, providing feedback that helps a teammate strengthen their approach. You dive deep into code, building a service component that must process thousands of transactions per second while staying resilient when downstream dependencies are unavailable. You join a cross-team sync with product managers to discuss upcoming requirements for an emerging market, then pair with a junior engineer on a tricky concurrency issue. Throughout the day, you balance hands-on engineering with the architectural thinking that keeps the platform reliable and ready for what comes next.  
  
About the team  
The Digital and Emerging Payments team is responsible for how Amazon customers pay across the globe. We build and run the systems that connect customers to the payment methods they trust, whether that is a credit card, a mobile wallet, or a region-specific option unique to their market. Our mission is to make every transaction feel simple and reliable.  
  
We are an inclusive group that values knowledge sharing and mentorship. Team members at every experience level contribute to technical decisions, and we invest in each person's growth by matching projects to development goals. If you want to shape the future of payments at Amazon's scale, we would love to hear from you.

title: Mainframe z/OS System Programmer

As a Mainframe z/OS System Programmer at Kyndryl, you’ll solve complex problems and identify potential future issues across the spectrum of platforms and services. You’ll be at the forefront of new technology and modernization, working with some of our biggest clients – which means some of the biggest in the world.
  
  
There’s never a typical day as a System Administrator at Kyndryl, because no two projects are alike. You’ll be managing systems data for clients and providing day-to-day solutions and security compliance. You’ll oversee a queue of assignments and work directly with technicians, prioritizing tickets to deliver the best solutions to our clients.
  
  
One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here. You’ll also get the chance to share your expertise by recommending modernization options, identifying new business opportunities, and cultivating relationships with other teams and stakeholders. Does the work get challenging at times? Yes! But you’ll collaborate with a diverse group of talented people and gain invaluable management and organizational skills, which will come in handy as you move forward in your career.
  
  
Your future at Kyndryl
  
Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career, from Junior System Administrator to Architect. We have opportunities for Cloud Hyperscale's that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

Required Technical and Professional Expertise

  

* Minimum 6+ years of experience in z/OS System Administration environment with work management, user management, journal management and performance management.
* Act as support and domain expert for z/OS operating system and system components; provide direct technical support as needed in the planning, coordination, installation, implementation and testing of releases, upgrades, or changes to z/OS operating system, network, and component software
* Primary support for assigned ISV products along with diagnose z/OS platform system and product issues and follow up with root cause analysis
* Analyze performance issues while providing technical consultation and inquiries from the other IT technical teams
* Support for new product installation and evaluation as needed.
* Participate in Disaster Recovery planning and tests as scheduled.
* Lead daily Operations meetings provided there are no P1 incidents running.
* Validated knowledge in the following technologies: z/OS, Unix System Services, SMP/E, REXX, Java, VSAM, Third party products.
Proven experience in providing support for ISV products.  

Preferred Technical and Professional Experience

  

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related field.
* Subject Matter Expert in Mainframe z/OS System Programming, with strong problem determination and resolution skills.
* Hands-on experience troubleshooting infrastructure and application-related issues within z/OS environments.
* Proficiency in IBM Systems Automation and mainframe operations management.
* Working knowledge of zCDP (z Systems Continuous Delivery Pipeline).
Working knowledge of z/OS Management Facility (z/OSMF).  

  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

title: Software Engineer
description:
**The Company**

PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.

We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.

We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.

Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.

**Job Summary:**

What you need to know about the role-
  
AI Ops & Engineering, part of PayPal’s Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) organization, is seeking a Software Engineer to help build and grow our AI based Reliability Solutions Practice.
  
  
Meet our team
  
PayPal SRE is a continuous engineering discipline that combines software development and systems engineering to build and run scalable, distributed, fault-tolerant systems. The SRE team works together to drive continuous improvement in capacity and performance. AI Ops & Engineering team enables innovation and builds enterprise-wide platforms to support reliability.

**Job Description:**

**Essential Responsibilities:**

* Implements tasks within the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), receiving structure and oversight from more experienced staff
* Follows well-established internal conventions and standard procedures
* Understands internal standards & processes an applies them to make technical decisions
* Collaborates with peers, manager, and project lead to gain understanding of tasks and review solutions
* May contribute to code & design reviews

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* 1+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

**Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications****:**

**Your way to impact**

In this role, you’ll build scalable, reliable platforms and services that strengthen system reliability and improve engineering productivity across PayPal’s Site Reliability Engineering organization. Your work will enable automation at scale, reduce operational toil, and deliver real-time insights that help engineers across the business. Familiarity with AI or GenAI is a plus, and you’ll have opportunities to apply it where it adds value.

As an engineer in AI Ops & Engineering, you’ll contribute to how reliability engineering evolves at PayPal, helping shape architecture, best practices, and product direction. You’ll be part of a collaborative, high-performance team that brings modern technology into mission-critical environments.

  
  

**Your day to day**

In your day-to-day role, you will:

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services and platforms for Site Reliability use cases using Java.
* Build and deploy production-grade applications and RESTful APIs that are scalable, secure, and maintainable.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with product, infrastructure, and SRE teams to translate reliability pain points into effective engineering solutions.
* Contribute to system design and architecture decisions that ensure scalability, reliability, and maintainability.
* Write clean, well-tested code, participate in code reviews, and follow engineering best practices.
* Share knowledge within the team.
* Where relevant, explore opportunities to apply AI/GenAI to improve automation and engineering workflows.
  

  

**What do you need to bring-**

* A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 3+ years of experience designing, developing, and deploying scalable software
* Experience with front-end technologies such as React.js or Node.js.
* Strong Java coding skills, with hands-on experience building scalable applications and services.
* Experience with RESTful APIs, microservices, and cloud platforms.
* Solid understanding of system design principles and experience with large-scale, fault-tolerant distributed systems.
* Experience working in Agile, fast-paced environments, with the ability to collaborate across teams.
* Good analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Flexibility and willingness to learn new technologies and adapt quickly.

**Nice to have**

* Knowledge of AI/GenAI concepts such as LLMs, prompt engineering, or RAG.
* Familiarity with tools like Python, LangChain, or LLM APIs.

title: System Development Engineer I, Amazon
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon Selection and Catalog Systems (ASCS) builds the systems that host and run the world’s largest e-Commerce products catalog. We power the online buying experience for customers worldwide so they can find, discover, and buy anything they want. Our massively scaled out distributed systems process hundreds of millions of updates on the billions of products across physical, digital, and services offerings. To achieve this, we develop the algorithms and build the systems and tools to ensure the safety of the selection and maximize their impact on the Amazon top-line, all the while continuously growing the overall selection. We develop and apply technologies spanning parallel processing, storage, Machine Learning, Natural Language Processing, and Image Recognition.  
  
You will be part of Services Support Team under Catalog Support and Programs (CSP) in ASCS Org. The mission of the Catalog Support and Programs (CSP) team is to provide a single point of contact for item-related problems and issues related to all retail and merchant catalog. As a member of ASCS team, you’ll play a key role in driving Amazon’s business. You will be responsible for providing Service Level issue support to all ASCS Engineering teams who built tier 1-3 systems and keep their software packages/configurations free from vulnerability, setup and monitor new metrics and alarms for their systems and drive root cause resolutions to the recurrent issues. You will build tools to improve operational efficiency.  
  
This role requires an individual with excellent System/Tool coding abilities along with AWS services understanding. The successful candidate will be a self-starter, comfortable with ambiguity, have strong attention to detail, and will be comfortable accessing and working with data from multiple sources. The candidate should also have strong communication skills, enabling them to work with Engineering team to understand requirements and shape analytical deliverables. Candidate should also have a demonstrated ability to think strategically and analytically about business, product, and technical challenges, with the ability to work cross-organizationally. A keen sense of ownership and drive is must. The role will work with a diverse set of data and cross-functional teams as well as use data to drive process improvement. An ideal engineer is one who enjoys discovering and solving ambiguous problems, can quickly learn complex systems, and enjoys building actionable insights from data.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* You handle all incoming system and service tickets with responsibilities covering multiple products, features and services.
* Software deployment support in staging and production environments.
* Given a defined problem, you deliver a solution which is logical, maintainable, that uses appropriate technologies, and is delivered on time.
* You learn current engineering best practices and get their designs, code & procedures reviewed, and incorporate feedback.
* You identify and scope problems and opportunities arising from technical discussions, calculate costs of proposed solutions, and make technical trade-offs.
* You contribute to operational excellence and perform troubleshooting to resolve defects.
* Drive Company Wide Campaigns and keep the Compliance risks (SAS, Shepherd etc.) for ASCS systems under control.

  
A day in the life  
Big Picture: Solve problems at their root, stepping back to understand the broader context  
  
Proactive: You display energy and initiative in solving problems.
  
  
Adaptable: You undertake a variety of tasks willingly. You switch from complex to routine tasks when required. You adapt quickly to new technologies and products.  
  
Quality: You demonstrate appropriate quality and thoroughness.  
  
Integrity: You act with personal integrity at all times  
  
About the team  
Catalog Support and Programs (CSP) provides program management and WW user technical support as a single point of contact for issues related to catalog systems and tools. We own implementation of business logic and configurations for these services and systems. We increase selection by on-boarding new vendors, integrating new catalog feeds and by configuring new marketplace, merchant and category setups. We drive strategic cross-functional programs that span across multiple catalog engineering teams

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Experience in automating, deploying, and supporting infrastructure
* Experience programming with at least one modern language such as Python, Ruby, Golang, Java, C++, C#, Rust
* Experience with Linux/Unix
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related field
* Knowledge of at least one modern programming language such as C, C++, Java, or Perl
* Experience with automation, testing, or monitoring framework development
* 1+ years of DevOps or SysOps in a large-scale software development environment experience
* Experience identifying bugs in architecture, algorithms, functionality, and performance with strong overall debugging skills

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience with CI/CD pipelines build processes
* Knowledge of and proficiency in the use of Python scripting language
* Experience on highly concurrent, high throughput systems and knowledge of complex distributed systems
* Knowledge of AWS services
* Experience developing and executing campaigns across a multitude of timezones and languages
* Experience with software development lifecycle, or experience in software development

description:

------------

Qualcomm India Private Limited

Engineering Group, Engineering Group \> Software Engineering
**General Summary:**

At Qualcomm, you will join a global leader in semiconductor technology and help shape the future of AI at the edge. You will work alongside world\-class engineers, architects, and product leaders to define the software architecture that enables AI experiences across a diverse range of products, including wearables, smartphones, XR devices, automotive platforms, edge computing systems, and AI PCs.


The Core Platform Software Architecture team is seeking an experienced and highly influential Principal Engineer, AI Platform Software Architecture to drive the software and system architecture for next\-generation AI inferencing platforms. In this role, you will lead cross\-functional architectural initiatives spanning software, hardware, security, memory systems, and AI accelerators while helping shape the long\-term technology strategy for Qualcomm's AI platform roadmap.


**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 8\+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience.

OR
  

Master's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 7\+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience.
  

OR
  

PhD in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 6\+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience.
  

  

* 4\+ years of work experience with Programming Language such as C, C\+\+, Java, Python, etc.

The successful candidate will serve as a technical leader responsible for influencing software and silicon architecture decisions across multiple product lines and future generations of AI platforms.


\-


Key Responsibilities


* Define and drive the long\-term platform software architecture and technical strategy for AI inferencing across Qualcomm's portfolio of edge AI products, influencing technology investments and architectural decisions across multiple product generations.

* Collaborate with product management, customers, and silicon architecture teams to understand emerging AI workloads, product requirements, and technology trends, and translate them into platform architecture and roadmap recommendations.
* Drive hardware/software co\-design and influence future platform capabilities through architectural analysis, technical proposals, and strategic technology planning.
* Lead system\-level architecture and engineering efforts spanning operating systems, AI runtimes, memory systems, virtualization, security, interconnects, and heterogeneous compute architectures.
* Evaluate architectural alternatives, perform tradeoff analysis, and develop architecture proposals and specifications that balance performance, power, scalability, security, and product requirements.
* Drive alignment across organizations through architecture reviews, technical leadership, and effective stakeholder engagement.
* Mentor and influence engineers and architects across the company while helping establish architectural best practices, technical standards, and long\-term technology direction.

\-


Preferred Qualifications


* 15\+ years of experience architecting complex embedded, platform, or systems software solutions.
* Demonstrated success driving architecture and technical strategy across multiple product generations and organizations.
* Strong experience in hardware/software interface design, system architecture, and end\-to\-end platform engineering.
* Deep expertise in several of the following areas:

o SoC and computer architecture


o ARM and RISC\-V architectures


o Linux kernel, operating systems, and device drivers


o Memory management and memory subsystem architecture


o DMA, IOMMU, and system interconnect technologies


o Virtualization and hypervisor technologies


o Security architecture, trusted execution environments, attestation, confidential computing, and model protection


o AI inferencing runtimes, frameworks, compilers, and software stacks


o Large Language Models (LLMs), Transformer architectures, and modern AI workloads


o Heterogeneous computing systems involving CPUs, GPUs, DSPs, NPUs, and dedicated AI accelerators


* Proven ability to influence senior technical leaders and drive consensus across geographically distributed teams.
* Excellent communication, leadership, and technical presentation skills.

title: Sr Principal Software Engineer - MAC
description:
**Role Summary::**


We are looking for a Sr Principal Software Engineer, Mac UI Engineer to lead the design and development of high\-quality, customer\-facing Mac desktop experiences. This is a senior individual contributor role for an engineer who combines deep technical expertise with strong product thinking, architectural judgment, and cross\-functional influence.


The ideal candidate brings strong proficiency in Swift, Objective\-C, and C/C\+\+, along with a proven ability to build polished, performant, and reliable Mac user interfaces at scale. This role requires close collaboration with product management, design, platform, and quality teams to deliver intuitive user experiences while driving sound engineering practices across the organization.


Experience using AI tools to improve engineering productivity, code quality, and development workflows is a strong plus.

**What You Will Do::**

* Architect, design, and develop modern Mac UI features for customer\-facing desktop applications
* Lead implementation of complex UI workflows using Swift, Objective\-C, and C/C\+\+
* Drive technical direction for Mac UI architecture, maintainability, scalability, and performance
* Partner with product managers, designers, backend engineers, and QA to translate product requirements into elegant user experiences
* Own critical technical decisions across the UI layer, including frameworks, patterns, integrations, and code quality standards
* Review code, provide technical guidance, and raise the engineering bar through strong design and implementation practices
* Mentor engineers through technical leadership, design reviews, and day\-to\-day collaboration while remaining hands\-on in development
* Troubleshoot complex production issues across UI, system integration, memory, performance, and stability areas
* Advocate for usability, accessibility, responsiveness, and consistency across the Mac user experience
* Contribute to continuous improvement in engineering workflows, release quality, and developer productivity
* Evaluate and apply AI\-assisted development tools where they can improve speed, quality, or team effectiveness

**Required Qualifications::**

* 10\+ years of experience with Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
* Extensive software engineering experience with significant hands\-on development in Mac application engineering
* Strong proficiency in Swift, Objective\-C, and C/C\+\+
* Deep experience building native Mac UI applications and shipping customer\-facing desktop products
* Strong understanding of macOS application architecture, UI frameworks, event\-driven programming, and system\-level behavior
* Proven experience designing scalable, maintainable, and performant software systems
* Strong debugging and problem\-solving skills across UI, application, and platform layers
* Demonstrated ability to influence technical direction across teams without direct people management responsibility
* Experience working in cross\-functional product development environments
* Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical tradeoffs clearly to engineering and non\-engineering stakeholders

**Preferred Qualifications::**

* Experience modernizing legacy Mac codebases and evolving mixed\-language applications
* Experience integrating UI layers with platform services, local system components, or shared libraries
* Familiarity with automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, and release engineering for desktop applications
* Strong understanding of software quality, security, performance optimization, and observability
* Experience partnering closely with UX and product teams to refine customer journeys and interaction design
* Experience using AI tools for coding assistance, test generation, code review acceleration, documentation, or developer workflow improvement
* Exposure to AI\-powered product features, assistant workflows, or developer tooling is a plus

**Leadership Expectations::**

* Operate as a senior technical leader and trusted expert for Mac UI engineering
* Balance hands\-on execution with architectural ownership and long\-term technical stewardship
* Influence engineering practices, design quality, and delivery outcomes across multiple teams
* Bring a strong product mindset and make decisions that improve customer experience as well as engineering health
* Raise the standard for code quality, design reviews, technical decision\-making, and cross\-team collaboration

**Success in This Role::**

* Deliver high\-impact Mac UI features that improve customer experience and product quality
* Strengthen the architecture and long\-term maintainability of the Mac UI codebase
* Help teams move faster through sound technical decisions, reusable patterns, and strong engineering practices
* Serve as a go\-to technical leader for complex UI and platform integration challenges
* Champion thoughtful adoption of modern development practices, including effective use of AI\-assisted engineering tools.
